subject: Painting (Fine Arts)

source.title: Fine Arts (Painting, Graphics, Sculpture, Applied Art), Codes 049-052, Classes XI-XII (2026-27)

notes: Theory (History of Indian Art, 30 marks, 2 hours) is common to Painting, Graphics, Sculpture and Applied Art. The practical paper (70 marks, 6 hours) is specific to each.
Questions are set only from the artworks listed.

units.name: Pre-Historic Rock Paintings, Indus Civilisation; Buddhist, Jain and Hindu Art

Indus sites: Harappa, Mohenjo-daro, Ropar, Lothal, Rangpur, Alamgirpur, Kalibangan, Banawali, Dholavira
Bronze casting; Dancing Girl, Male Torso, Mother Goddess
Bull seal; painted earthenware jar

chapters.name: Buddhist, Jain and Hindu Art (3rd century BCE to 8th century CE)

Lion Capital from Sarnath; Chauri Bearer from Didarganj; Seated Buddha from Katra Mound; Jain Tirthankara (Gupta)
Ajanta: location, period, chaitya and vihara caves, Bodhisattva Padmapani; rock-cut architecture, sculpture, fresco
